Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Improved damage-over-time calibration by retaining pre-pull healing observations when supported duties start. Healing does not count as damage or start the encounter timer. Added coverage for calibration lifecycle, duplicate observations, and job and level changes while preserving death-review behavior and existing content restrictions.
